summary: Add deterministic expiresAt-ascending sort to the existing authorized soft-hold collection list (GET /reservations / Reservation::list); equal expiresAt may use any stable order; AuthZ, shared visibility, unfiltered full-dump item shape, and UnauthorizedError remain unchanged; no filters, paging, or DTO changes; prior reserve/release/expire/lookup/concurrent stay in force.
goal: Authorized opaque principals receive the existing full dump of currently visible soft-holds ordered by expiresAt ascending (earlier expiry first; ties any stable order) without mutating stock or holds; unauthorized list remains UnauthorizedError with no mutation; sort is machine-checkable via OpenAPI and/or OCL + Vitest.
